# Minnie Andrews & Phillips

- [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) — Mentor of — [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md) — pupil in his schoolroom · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic goodbye after Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forbids [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she is warmly welcomed by her classmates, exchanges secret notes with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and enters a fierce academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

A New Interest in Life P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home after emotional farewells on the last day of school and learns about the arrival of the new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. She bonds with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) at Sunday school and helps prepare a lavish tea for the couple at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). However, when Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) taste the layer cake [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) specially baked for the occasion, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reacts in dismay to its strange taste.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings
